# ApexHive Labs — Engineering Portfolio

> ApexHive Labs builds local-first developer, payments, operations, email security, and read-only trading risk software across four engineering areas.

## AI Agent & MCP Tools
- `slimmcp-proxy` (`v1.0.3`, MIT, `Node >=22.13 LTS`): Stops AI agents from burning context tokens loading dozens of unused MCP tool schemas by exposing 3 lightweight meta-tools across `stdio`, `Streamable-HTTP`, and `SSE` (`discover_tools`, `inspect_tool_schema`, `invoke_tool`), BM25 search, fail-closed secret redaction, isolated child env, and deny-overrides RBAC/budget guardrails. Benchmark (60 tools): `60,185 -> 1,286` bytes (`97.86%` initial reduction: `15,047 -> 322` tok; `~14,310` tok saved / `95.10%` net 1-turn; `~737` tok spent).
  - GitHub: https://github.com/apexhive-hq/slimmcp-proxy
  - npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/slimmcp-proxy (`npx -y slimmcp-proxy --help`)
  - Official MCP Registry: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers/io.github.apexhive-hq%2Fslimmcp-proxy/versions/latest
  - Glama Directory: https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/apexhive-hq/slimmcp-proxy
- `mcp-doctor` (`v1.0.2`, MIT, `Node >=20 LTS`): Static CI security and context-tax linter for MCP configs and tool schemas — catches prompt-injection patterns, leaked credentials (masked secret evidence), untyped/bloated schemas, and policy violations (`A-F` score grading, isolated stdio env, SARIF 2.1.0, `--policy`, `--ci`).
  - GitHub: https://github.com/apexhive-hq/mcp-doctor
  - npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/apexhive-mcp-doctor (`npx -y apexhive-mcp-doctor status`)

## Payments & Web3 Ops
- `zerofiat-base-checkout-kit` (`v2.1.0`, MIT, `Node >=22.18 LTS`): Non-custodial Base Mainnet USDC (`eip155:8453`) payment verification on Cloudflare Workers with EOA (`EIP-191`) + Smart Wallet (`ERC-1271` / `EIP-6492`) signature proofs, scoped `TxClaimLockDO` anti-replay locks (`409` on replay), and offline Ed25519 receipts.
  - GitHub: https://github.com/apexhive-hq/zerofiat-base-checkout-kit
  - Live Reference Worker: https://zerofiat-base-checkout-kit.apexhive-hq.workers.dev
- `web3-ops-automation-pack` (`v1.0.1`, MIT, `Node >=22.18 LTS` / `Python 3.12+`): Four verification and QA modules — strict `BigInt` Base USDC watcher, `finalized` Solana SPL USDC verifier (TypeScript & Python), Playwright EIP-1193 checkout QA harness, and fail-closed HMAC-authenticated n8n webhook templates.
  - GitHub: https://github.com/apexhive-hq/web3-ops-automation-pack

## Operations & Email Defense
- `open-center-os` (`v2.2.0`, MIT, `Node >=24` for `node:sqlite`): Self-hosted multi-branch ERP for schools, studios, and service centers — student & CRM trial leads, weekly class timetables, QR check-in passes, POS invoicing & refunds, multi-branch revenue analytics, trilingual UI (EN/繁中/簡中) & bilingual EN/ZH receipts, and `scrypt` password hashing with SQLite session revocation.
  - GitHub: https://github.com/apexhive-hq/open-center-os
- `dmarczero` (`v1.0.0`, MIT, `Node >=20 LTS` CLI / `>=22.13` BYO Worker): Zero-dependency DNS/DMARC/TLS anti-drift guard & streaming `RUA` aggregate analyzer (strictly rejects `RUF` forensic PII), paired with an authenticated self-hosted Cloudflare Email Worker and customizable white-label HTML report.
  - GitHub: https://github.com/apexhive-hq/dmarczero

## Trading Risk Control
- `evalshield-copilot` (`v3.0.2`, ApexHive Dual Source-Available License — Solo local use: Free · Team: $99 USDC · Enterprise: $499 USDC): Read-only prop-firm and futures risk shield with 6 core modules: Drawdown Guard (Topstep, Apex, MFFU, FTMO 1&2-Step, Tradeify), Cross-Market Sizer (`ES/NQ/GC/CL`, `XAUUSD`, FX, `BTC/ETH/SOL` incl. `SOL-PERP`), Portfolio Anti-Hedge Check, Trade Journal (`node:sqlite`), Macro Event Calendar (2026-2027 Fed FOMC / BLS CPI / BLS NFP + US DST accuracy + Hyperliquid/Polymarket 15s brief), and 25,000-run Monte Carlo + fail-closed BYO Cloudflare Worker alert webhook (`deploy/cloudflare-byo/`) with DNS-validated IPv4/IPv6 SSRF protection. Zero broker API keys and zero automated order placement.
  - Live App: https://evalshield-copilot.apexhive-hq.workers.dev/
  - GitHub (ApexHive Dual Source-Available License): https://github.com/apexhive-hq/evalshield-copilot

## Quick Start
```bash
npx -y slimmcp-proxy --help
npx -y slimmcp-proxy serve --config /path/to/mcp-servers.json
npx -y apexhive-mcp-doctor status
```
